zh: MOTOR：系列一致性下的版本扩展与体验升级
en: MOTOR: Version Expansion & Experience Upgrade within Series Consistency

zh: 在保持系列识别一致的前提下，建立可扩展的版本迭代框架与体验升级组件。
en: Establishing an expandable version iteration framework and experience upgrade components while maintaining series recognition consistency.

zh: 在保持系列识别一致的前提下，建立可扩展的版本迭代框架与体验升级组件。
en: Establishing an expandable version iteration framework and experience upgrade components while maintaining series recognition consistency.

zh: 对照是判断差异最直接的方式
en: Comparison is the most direct way to judge differences

zh: 两款产品在视觉结构、比例与核心语言上保持一致，但在细节层面根据产品特性进行调整。
en: The two products maintain consistency in visual structure, proportion, and core language, while adjusting details according to product characteristics.

zh: 差异化是被系统允许的变化
en: Differentiation is change permitted by the system

zh: 核心组件保持一致的设计语言
en: Core components maintain consistent design language

zh: 从主体结构到细节配件，设计遵循同一套视觉逻辑与比例原则。
en: From main structure to detail components, design follows the same visual logic and proportion principles.

zh: 一致性从组件层面开始建立
en: Consistency starts from the component level

zh: 幻灯片展示
en: Slide Presentation

zh: 用「多国家 KV 套件」的模块化主视觉系统，在同一品牌骨架下替换人群、场景与语言信息，实现不同市场的快速适配与统一传播。
en: Using a modular「multi-country KV kit」key visual system to replace target audiences, scenes, and language information within the same brand framework, enabling rapid adaptation and unified communication across different markets.

zh: 配对文档展示
en: Paired Document Display

zh: 用「口味 KV 系列化模板」把同一传播骨架按口味拆成可批量扩展的主视觉资产，做到一眼可辨、风格统一，并支持渠道与社媒高频上新。
en: Using a「flavor KV serialization template」to split the same communication framework by flavor into batch-expandable key visual assets, achieving instant recognition, unified style, and supporting high-frequency updates for channels and social media.

zh: 产品画廊
en: Product Gallery

zh: 用「贴纸图形资产包」的模块化设计，把关键卖点、口味识别与品牌符号做成可快速印刷落地的线下物料，支持终端装饰、赠品活动与社群传播。
en: Using a modular「sticker graphic asset pack」design to turn key selling points, flavor identification, and brand symbols into quickly printable offline materials, supporting terminal decoration, promotional giveaways, and community outreach.

zh: 产品分组展示
en: Product Group Display

zh: 用「周边壳套 CMF 发散 + 纹理材质库 + 挂件搭配」的模块化探索，把保护与便携的功能需求转化为可量产、可联名、可做活动的周边体系，延展产品的日常使用与品牌表达。
en: Using a modular exploration of「accessory case CMF divergence + texture material library + pendant matching」to transform protection and portability needs into a mass-producible, co-brandable, campaign-ready accessory system, extending daily product use and brand expression.

zh: 卡片跑马灯
en: Cards Marquee

zh: 用「丝印图样库 + 版位规范」的模块化设计，为产品表面预留可快速更换的装饰层，在保持品牌调性的同时，支持季节限定、联名合作与小批量试水的灵活变化。
en: Using a modular「silk-screen pattern library + position specification」design to reserve a quickly replaceable decorative layer on product surfaces, supporting seasonal editions, brand collaborations, and small-batch trials while maintaining brand tonality.

zh: 产品网格
en: Product Grid

zh: 用「款式收敛 + 打样量产跟进 + 包装套件」的全链路管控，把发散探索的结果收拢为可落地的款式组合，确保每一个上市 SKU 都有清晰的定位与完整的配套。
en: Using a full-chain management of「style convergence + prototype-to-production follow-up + packaging kit」to converge exploratory results into viable style combinations, ensuring every launched SKU has clear positioning and complete supporting materials.

zh: 全景展示
en: Panorama Display

zh: 用「一页纸产品模块」的信息聚合设计，把产品核心规格、卖点亮点与视觉呈现集成在单屏快速浏览视图中，适用于内部培训、渠道速递与销售资料。
en: Using a「one-page product module」information aggregation design to integrate core product specs, key selling points, and visual presentation in a single-screen quick-view format, suitable for internal training, channel briefings, and sales materials.

zh: 跑马灯混合展示
en: Marquee Mixed Display

zh: 用「一次性烟弹包装 + 口味卡 + UI 图案复用」的模块化设计，把多口味标准化包装与信息组件串联起来，做到货架可辨、口味可读，并支撑社媒与终端的组合传播。
en: Using a modular「disposable pod packaging + flavor card + UI pattern reuse」design to connect multi-flavor standardized packaging with information components, achieving shelf recognition, flavor readability, and supporting combined social media and retail communications.

zh: 产品矩阵
en: Product Matrix

zh: 用「口味资源库」的系统化管理，把口味颜色、图标、名称、描述、气味分类等信息沉淀为可复用的数据集，支撑包装设计、营销物料与多语言适配的高效产出。
en: Using a systematic「flavor resource library」management to consolidate flavor colors, icons, names, descriptions, and scent classifications into a reusable dataset, supporting efficient production of packaging design, marketing materials, and multi-language adaptation.

zh: 文档聚焦
en: Document Focus

zh: 用「展架结构 + 信息分层 + 口味陈列逻辑」的终端设计，把产品展示做成一套可复制的零售标准，确保不同门店与渠道下的品牌呈现一致、信息清晰、导购顺畅。
en: Using a terminal design of「display rack structure + information layering + flavor display logic」to create a replicable retail standard for product display, ensuring consistent brand presentation, clear information, and smooth customer guidance across different stores and channels.

zh: 设计规范的系统化文档
en: Systematic documentation of design specifications

zh: 用「AI 生成模特街拍 + 真实生活场景实拍」的混合拍摄方案，把社媒素材制作变成可快速组合、按需出片的资产流水线，支撑多平台内容运营的高频上新。
en: Using a hybrid shooting approach of「AI-generated model street photography + real-life scene photography」to transform social media content production into a fast-combinable, on-demand asset pipeline, supporting high-frequency content updates across multiple platforms.

zh: 规范是一致性的保障
en: Specifications are the guarantee of consistency

zh: 品牌延展与应用示例
en: Brand extension and application examples

zh: 从产品到传播物料，品牌视觉在各类媒介中保持统一。
en: From products to communication materials, brand visuals maintain consistency across various media.

zh: 延展不是复制，是系统的自然生长
en: Extension is not copying, it's the natural growth of the system

zh: Product B 验证了品牌系统的可持续性
en: Product B validates the sustainability of the brand system

zh: 这一阶段的完成标志着品牌进入可复制扩展的成熟阶段。
en: The completion of this phase marks the brand entering a mature stage of replicable expansion.
